description:
Get the complete published record for one Fortitude21 product.
Use when: the user needs the specifications, sizes, part numbers or images of one product, usually after search_products. Instead: get_product_pricing for commercial terms; get_product_documents for certificates; check_product_requirements for what a quotation still needs.
Inputs: sku takes the product slug, with or without its product- prefix, the product part number, or the part number of one size, which returns the whole product that size belongs to. Letter case is ignored.
Returns: product with identity, typed specifications and the source of each figure, the spec table, orderable units with their part numbers, size and model tables, images, documents available on request and pricing.
Behaviour: a figure the factory has not supplied comes back as available on request, never left out, so an absent value is not read as zero. Any price in the record is indicative, never a quotation. An unknown sku returns ok:false with example ids and a search link.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.

sku.description: An F21 part number such as F21-NF-20, or a product slug such as product-20l-nato-steel-fuel-can. Both come from search_products results

name: get_product_details

assumed.description: Each value the tool inferred or defaulted, in words, so it can be checked with the user

cite.description: Credit line with a link, for quoting the answer

error.description: When ok is false: what is missing or could not be read, and what to send instead

ok.description: true with an answer. false when the tool needs one more input or cannot answer; error then says what to send

product.description: The full record: identity, attributes with provenance, specs, orderable units, size and model tables, images, documents and commercial terms

publisher.description: Who publishes the tool, the Fortitude21 products that fit, with links, and quote_url, a link to ask for a quotation

tool.description: Link to the same answer on the interactive tool page

title: Get one Fortitude21 product
